title.en: An Act Appropriating an Additional Sum of Twenty-Three Million Pesos as Counterpart Fund to Carry Out the Purposes of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred and Four
title.orig: An Act Appropriating an Additional Sum of Twenty-Three Million Pesos as Counterpart Fund to Carry Out the Purposes of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred and Four

text.en: The sum of twenty-three million pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as additional Counterpart Fund to carry out the purposes of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred and four.
This appropriation shall be available for expenditure until exhausted even after June thirty, nineteen hundred and fifty-seven.

This Act shall take effect July first, nineteen hundred fifty-six.
Approved: June 14, 1955.
